title: Writing C++ the Machine Can Run Fast
snippet: Two functions with the same big-O can differ by an order of magnitude in wall-clock time. The reason is rarely the algorithm on paper, it is how the code meets the machine: whether data is where the cache expects it,…

title: SWAR Parsing Internals

desc: How SIMD-Within-A-Register turns ordinary 64-bit integers into 8-lane parallel byte processors.
